recipes.title: Spicy Red Lentil & Spinach Dahl
recipes.ingredients:
500g Red Lentils
400g Brown Rice
3 Onions
Garlic
Fresh Spinach
2 Cans Diced Tomatoes
Rapeseed Oil
Curry powder/Turmeric/Cumin/Chili
recipes.instructions:
1. Cook brown rice and set aside.
2. Sauté onions and garlic in oil.
3. Stir in spices, then add rinsed lentils, tomatoes, and 1.5L water.
4. Simmer 25-30 mins until lentils are soft.
5. Stir in spinach at the end and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Lazy Gołąbki Casserole
recipes.ingredients:
400g Buckwheat
3 Cans White Beans
1 Head White Cabbage
3 Onions
500g Mushrooms
3 Cartons Tomato Passata
Marjoram
recipes.instructions:
1. Cook buckwheat partially. Drain beans.
2. Sauté onions and mushrooms.
3. Add chopped cabbage and sauté 15 mins.
4. Mix in buckwheat, beans, and passata.
5. Season with marjoram and simmer 20 mins.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Pearl Barley Stew
recipes.ingredients:
400g Pearl Barley
3 Cans Chickpeas
2 Bell Peppers
2 Zucchinis
2 Red Onions
2 Cans Diced Tomatoes
Oregano/Basil/Smoked Paprika
recipes.instructions:
1. Boil pearl barley until tender.
2. Sauté onions, peppers, zucchini, and garlic.
3. Add tomatoes, chickpeas, and cooked barley.
4. Season and simmer 15 mins.

recipes.title: Hearty Root Vegetable Soup
recipes.ingredients:
500g Yellow Split Peas
1.5kg Potatoes
1kg Carrots
1 Celery Root
3 Onions
Smoked Paprika/Bay Leaves/Marjoram
recipes.instructions:
1. Soak split peas. Dice all root vegetables.
2. Sauté onions.
3. Add peas, veg, bay leaves, and 2.5L water.
4. Simmer 45-60 mins until peas break down.
5. Season with smoked paprika and marjoram.

recipes.title: Lean Chicken & Bean Chili
recipes.ingredients:
500g Chicken Breast
3 Cans Kidney Beans
400g Brown Rice
2 Red Peppers
2 Onions
2 Cans Sweet Corn
3 Cans Diced Tomatoes
recipes.instructions:
1. Cook rice. Dice chicken and veg.
2. Brown chicken and sauté onions/peppers.
3. Add spices, then tomatoes, beans, and corn.
4. Simmer 20-25 mins and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Smoked Mackerel Avocado Mash
recipes.ingredients:
1 Smoked Mackerel fillet
1 ripe Avocado
1 tbsp Lemon juice
Black pepper
Fresh Dill
recipes.instructions:
1. Flake mackerel.
2. Mash avocado.
3. Mix with lemon and pepper.
4. Serve on keto bread.

recipes.title: Flaxseed & Walnut N'oats
recipes.ingredients:
30g Ground Flaxseed
20g Walnuts
100ml Almond Milk
Cinnamon
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix flax and milk.
2. Heat until thick.
3. Top with walnuts.

recipes.title: Tofu Scramble with Spinach
recipes.ingredients:
200g Firm Tofu
100g Spinach
Turmeric
Nutritional Yeast
recipes.instructions:
1. Crumble tofu in pan.
2. Sauté with spices.
3. Wilt in spinach.

recipes.title: Chia & Berry Skyr Bowl
recipes.instructions:
1. Mix chia and skyr.
2. Set for 10 mins.
3. Top with berries.

recipes.title: Almond Savory Pancakes
recipes.instructions:
1. Whisk batter.
2. Fry in pan until golden.

recipes.title: Herb-Crusted Baked Cod
recipes.ingredients:
2 Cod Fillets
30g Almond Flour
Parsley
Lemon
recipes.instructions:
1. Coat fish in flour/herbs.
2. Bake at 200C for 15 mins.

recipes.title: Turkey & Zucchini Stir-fry
recipes.instructions:
1. Fry turkey.
2. Add veg and soy sauce.
3. Toss until tender.

recipes.title: Tofu Lentil Bolognese
recipes.instructions:
1. Sauté veg.
2. Add crumbled tofu.
3. Add lentils and tomatoes.
4. Simmer.

recipes.title: Golden Flax Seed Bread
recipes.instructions: 1. Mix and bake in loaf tin at 180C for 45 mins.

recipes.title: Chocolate Brownies
recipes.ingredients:
150g Dark Choc
100g Butter
100g Erythritol
50g Almond Flour
recipes.instructions:
1. Melt choc/butter.
2. Stir in rest.
3. Bake for 20 mins.
